title: Contx
tagline: This is a new type of CV for the web3 version, called Work CRDL. You will no longer have to struggle with writing a CV or selling yourself. Everyone will be able to take their trust-free CV with them wherever they go, simply by working as usual.
description:
This project will give on-chain payment transactions information about why they were paid and what they were paid for.
Currently on-chain transactions only have financial data, but these pieces of information are very inadequate to a person's identity.
On the other hand, in today's society, information about a person's achievements and skills is not reliable. The large market size of background check services confirms this fact.
We believe that expanding the range of data that can be published on the on-chain while ensuring the reliability of non-financial data by linking it to on-chain financial data will benefit both the web2/web3 worlds, and this project is a very exciting social PoC. It also has the potential to become a component of SBT, SSI, and Decentralized Identity.
how_its_made:
IPFS/Web3.Storage as a datastore, and The graph enables us to tie on-chain transactions to off-chain data. Wallet Connect and Metamask are also used for payments. We are also using Ceramic Network's DID Datastore to provide proof of individual performance. I do not believe that NFT is suitable for proving personal identity, etc.
NFT has the power to make it scarce and to express rights, but there are several difficulties in expressing personal achievements.
For those reasons, I try to express identity through tech stacks, which are different from NFT.
